components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: oklch(0.2 0.04 27.17 / 0.8); border: 1px solid oklch(0.277 0.083 29.660); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: oklch(0.991 0.002 23.598); } .ds-card-title { font-family: sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.17 0.02 25.92); margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: HandyBet is a premium, high-energy P2P social betting platform. Its visual identity rejected the flat, dull corporate interfaces in favor of a sleek, dark cyber-casino lounge. It relies heavily on translucent glassmorphism layers, glowing accent lights, and clean technical typography.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian and midnight blue backgrounds.
High-contrast, vibrant neon indicators (Mint/Emerald, Indigo, Gold).
Subtle, semi-transparent borders to simulate physical glass panes.
Generous, ergonomic spacing designed for comfortable mobile and desktop navigation.

rules.name: The Neon Rarity Rule
rules.body: Neon accents should not cover more than 10% of any screen. Their vibrance is meant to draw attention, not flood the user's vision.

rules.name: The Matte Glass Rule
rules.body: Card backdrops must use an opacity between 70% and 90% combined with a heavy blur to maintain legibility.

dos: Do use backdrop-blur-md on all floating layout panels and headers.
Do use font-mono or font-bold tracking-wider for numeric values, tickets, and codes.
Do wrap icons in rounded-full backgrounds with 10% opacity of the icon color.
donts: Don't use solid gray borders (e.g. #cccccc). Use translucent white borders (border-white/10).
Don't use emojis as primary navigation tab icons. Replaced entirely by SVG icons.
